premises.text: Lab-centric monthly milk testing is slow, labor-intensive, and leaves farmers without real-time herd health information such as early mastitis detection
premises.evidence_span: this lab-centric testing is time-consuming, labor-intensive, and often prone to human errors

premises.text: A handheld optical milk analyzer with embedded ML captures reagent-free milk quality metrics in about ten seconds
premises.evidence_span: The hardware can capture the optical data from milk directly without any chemicals

premises.text: A portal provides customized herd- and cow-level data visualization for milk quality and health management
premises.evidence_span: a portal with customized data visual for milk quality and health management

premises.text: Remote veterinary support from animal care partners supplies best-practice recommendations
premises.evidence_span: a remote veterinary support from our animal care partners for best practices and recommendations

premises.text: The solution scales across dairy producers, co-ops, and processors along the supply chain
premises.evidence_span: easily scale up entire supply chain from dairy producers, to dairy co-op and dairy processors

domains.name: optical analyzer portal and vet support

value.text: Real-time milk quality and animal health management that improves dairy profitability
value.evidence_span: improving animal health and profitability, we can really reshape the dairy industry
